query: SELECT workspace_id AS "workspace_id!" FROM (/* API token super-admin permissions */ SELECT user_api_token_workspace_super_admin.workspace_id FROM user_login INNER JOIN user_api_token_workspace_super_admin ON user_api_token_workspace_super_admin.token_id = user_login.login_id WHERE user_login.login_id = $1 AND user_login.login_type = 'api_token'  UNION ALL  /* Web login super-admin permissions (workspace owners) */ SELECT workspace.id AS workspace_id FROM user_login INNER JOIN workspace ON workspace.super_admin_id = user_login.user_id WHERE user_login.login_id = $1 AND user_login.login_type = 'web_login') AS super_admins;
